{=taom_wotr_desc_battle}Army of {WINNER_FACTION}, led by {WINNER_LEADER}, destroyed the army of {LOSER_FACTION}, led by {LOSER_LEADER}, killing {CASUALTIES}.
{=taom_wotr_desc_siege}Army of {FACTION}, led by {LEADER}, captured {SETTLEMENT}.
{=taom_wotr_desc_raid}{PARTY} of {FACTION} raided the village of {SETTLEMENT}.
{=taom_wotr_desc_army}An army led by {LEADER} has gathered.
{=taom_wotr_desc_strength}We are {PERCENTAGE}% stronger than our enemies!
{=taom_wotr_desc_kills}Our forces slew {CASUALTIES} enemies in battle.
{=taom_wotr_victory_title}End of the War
{=taom_wotr_victory_free}The war is over. The Free Peoples have persevered, and won the future for their children. Long live freedom!
{=taom_wotr_victory_evil}The realms of Men and Elf alike have been crushed. Long live Sauron!
{=taom_wotr_chronicle_events}Chronicle Events
{=taom_wc_siege_lost}{TARGET} changes hands before the battle can be decided.
{=taom_wc_fellowship_title}The Fellowship Sets Out
{=taom_wc_fellowship_occurred}Nine walkers leave Rivendell in secret, bearing the One Ring south. The house of Elrond gathers its strength.
{=taom_wc_khazaddum_title}The Bridge of Khazad-dûm
{=taom_wc_khazaddum_occurred}In the deeps of Moria the Grey Pilgrim falls with the Balrog. The orcs of the Misty Mountains swarm, and the Free Peoples mourn.
{=taom_wc_breaking_title}The Breaking of the Fellowship
{=taom_wc_breaking_occurred}At Parth Galen the Uruk-hai fall upon the Company. Boromir dies defending the hobbits, and Gondor loses its heir.
{=taom_wc_breaking_averted}At Parth Galen the Uruk-hai are thrown back. Boromir lives, and Gondor keeps its Captain-General.
{=taom_wc_theoden_title}Théoden King
{=taom_wc_theoden_occurred}Freed from the counsel of Wormtongue, Théoden takes up his sword. The Riddermark musters to its king.
{=taom_wc_hornburg_title}The Battle of the Hornburg
{=taom_wc_hornburg_open}The host of Isengard and the hillmen of Dunland march on {TARGET}. The battle must be decided within {DAYS} days.
{=taom_wc_hornburg_lapsed}No assault comes to {TARGET}. The muster of Isengard turns elsewhere.
{=taom_wc_hornburg_fate}The host of Isengard storms {TARGET} through the night, and at dawn the Hornburg still stands.
{=taom_wc_hornburg_held}The Hornburg holds through the night, and the host of Isengard breaks against its walls.
{=taom_wc_hornburg_fell}{TARGET} falls, and the White Hand rules the Westfold.
{=taom_wc_hornburg_repulsed}The assault on {TARGET} breaks. Sauron is angry that Saruman's greed spoiled his plan, and Mordor ends its alliance with Isengard.
{=taom_wc_ents_title}The Last March of the Ents
{=taom_wc_ents_occurred}The Ents of Fangorn come down upon Isengard and drown the pits of Saruman. The forges of the White Hand fall silent.
{=taom_wc_lorien_title}Lothlórien Assailed
{=taom_wc_lorien_open}Out of Dol Guldur the Shadow assails the Golden Wood. {TARGET} must stand for {DAYS} days.
{=taom_wc_lorien_lapsed}The armies of Dol Guldur never reach {TARGET}.
{=taom_wc_lorien_held}The power of the Lady holds, and the hosts of Dol Guldur fall back from the Golden Wood.
{=taom_wc_lorien_fell}{TARGET} burns, and the light of Lothlórien wanes.
{=taom_wc_osgiliath_title}The Fall of Osgiliath
{=taom_wc_osgiliath_open}The Morgul host crosses the Anduin toward {TARGET}. Gondor must hold the ruined city for {DAYS} days.
{=taom_wc_osgiliath_lapsed}Mordor does not come against {TARGET}, and the river stays quiet.
{=taom_wc_osgiliath_held}Faramir holds the crossings of the Anduin, and the Morgul host draws back.
{=taom_wc_osgiliath_fell}{TARGET} falls, and the road to Minas Tirith lies open.
{=taom_wc_dale_title}The Battle of Dale
{=taom_wc_dale_open}Easterlings and the servants of Dol Guldur march against the realm of Dale. {TARGET} must hold for {DAYS} days.
{=taom_wc_dale_lapsed}The Easterlings turn aside, and {TARGET} is spared.
{=taom_wc_dale_held}Men of Dale and Dwarves of Erebor stand together, and the Easterling host is thrown back.
{=taom_wc_dale_fell}{TARGET} falls to the Easterlings, and the Dwarves of Erebor ride out to aid their friends.
{=taom_wc_corsairs_title}The Corsairs of Umbar
{=taom_wc_corsairs_open}The black sails of Umbar come up the Anduin toward {TARGET}. Gondor must hold the port for {DAYS} days.
{=taom_wc_corsairs_lapsed}The Corsairs linger at sea, and {TARGET} is left in peace.
{=taom_wc_corsairs_held}The fleets of Umbar are driven from {TARGET}, and the southern fiefs of Gondor take heart.
{=taom_wc_corsairs_fell}The Corsairs seize {TARGET}, and their ships command the river.
{=taom_wc_north_title}War in the North
{=taom_wc_north_open}Orcs of Gundabad and the hillmen of Dunland come down on the North. {TARGET} must hold for {DAYS} days.
{=taom_wc_north_lapsed}The northern war passes {TARGET} by.
{=taom_wc_north_held}The Rangers and the men of Arthedain hold {TARGET}, and the North stays free.
{=taom_wc_north_fell}{TARGET} falls, and the shadow spreads across Eriador.
{=taom_wc_gondor_title}The Siege of Gondor
{=taom_wc_gondor_open}The Lord of the Nazgûl leads the hosts of Mordor against {TARGET}. The city must hold for {DAYS} days.
{=taom_wc_gondor_lapsed}The great host of Mordor holds back, and {TARGET} waits under a darkened sky.
{=taom_wc_gondor_held}The Rohirrim come at dawn, and the siege of {TARGET} is broken on the Pelennor Fields.
{=taom_wc_gondor_fell}The gates of {TARGET} are broken, and the White City falls to Mordor.
{=taom_wc_blackgate_title}The Black Gate Opens
{=taom_wc_blackgate_occurred}The Captains of the West march to the Morannon to draw the Eye from the Ring-bearer. The fate of the war now rests with the Ring.
